title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten named Hudson Valley outdoor destinations for an admission-free walk, picnic, or nature break near Marist University.

cards.title: Walk Black Creek Preserve
cards.subtitle: Esopus, NY — near Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a trail walk or shoreline pause; use the preserve’s posted visitor guidance and stay on marked routes.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost preserve outing with trails and Hudson River shoreline access.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Black Creek Preserve as one of its parks, and states that all Scenic Hudson parks are open daily free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge; check the preserve page for current alerts and visitor rules before leaving.

cards.title: Take a Peach Hill Park loop
cards.subtitle: Poughkeepsie, NY
cards.notes: Meet for a walk, picnic, or wildlife watch between dawn and dusk; pack water and use the park’s designated trails.
cards.short_summary: A Poughkeepsie park for a simple, free outdoors hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson says Peach Hill Park is free and open year-round, dawn to dusk, and lists hiking, picnicking, and wildlife activities.
cards.access_notes: Free year-round, dawn to dusk, according to Scenic Hudson. Bring any food or gear you want; no purchase is required to enter.

cards.title: Picnic at Esopus Meadows Preserve
cards.subtitle: Ulster Park, NY — near Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Plan a low-key trail-and-pavilion meetup, then take the shoreline route to the river lookout before sunset.
cards.short_summary: A free preserve with trails, a pavilion, and river views.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson says Esopus Meadows Preserve is free and open year-round, sunrise to sunset, and offers hiking and picnicking.
cards.access_notes: Free year-round, sunrise to sunset. Seasonal facilities may vary, so review the preserve page’s alerts before visiting.

cards.title: See Esopus Meadows Lighthouse
cards.subtitle: Esopus, NY — near Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Use this small riverfront park for a conversation walk and lighthouse view; pair it with the adjacent preserve if you want more trail time.
cards.short_summary: A named riverfront park with a view of Esopus Meadows Lighthouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Lighthouse Park as a public park in Esopus and lists walking, fishing, wildlife watching, and dog walking on leash.
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge. The park is owned by the Town of Esopus; follow local park guidance.
